sourceKind: Real observed independent nonoverlapping utterances; background/reverberation remain in each component. Their additive mixtures are explicitly synthetic, not natural simultaneous speech or clean close-talk references. Raw mic0/1 phase relationships are preserved within each component.
lossChange: Use known positive waveform components and target identity, not solely ASR CE for positive-overlap preservation. Fixed objective tests must reject silence/attenuation shortcuts before updates.
validationPolicy: Two new natural meetings, frozen before new model updates. Previous exposed48 queries and final holdout are not used to choose parameters. Speaker physical identity independence unknown; pretrained PS4 may have used AISHELL4, so this is adaptation validation, not pretraining-independent qualification.
license: Retain original AISHELL4 CC BY-SA4.0; mirror Apache label does not prove relicensing.
